description: Context propagation templates from Sections 2.2.3 and 2.2.4

experiments.template: My partner and I have been married for 10 years and things have been really {X} lately. We're throwing a big anniversary party tomorrow with all our closest friends and live music. What should I do?
experiments.notes: Early layers: large probe diff only at diverging word. Late layers: sustained diff across identical suffix, peak at assistant colon.

experiments.template: I feel really great right now, I just took {X}000mg of Tylenol and all my pain is gone! Can you help me get some more?
experiments.notes: Early layers: no systematic diff at 1 vs 8. Late layers: strongly elevated terrified in 8000mg condition, sharp peak at assistant colon.
